evals.prompt: turn my README into a landing page
evals.expected_output: README.md rewritten with landing page structure (hero, problem, solution, how it works, social proof, FAQ, CTA). README.backup.md created as backup. Technical content preserved in <details> blocks. The run closes with a Final Report.
expectations: Ran Repo Sync (stash-first) before rewriting README.md, or recorded sync: skipped with its reason
Created README.backup.md before rewriting README.md
Chose and named a framework (PAS, AIDA, or StoryBrand) and offered the user an override
Preserved all original technical content in README.backup.md and collapsed <details> blocks
Ran the Step 6 Self-Review Checklist and fixed any failures before presenting
Did not commit the rewrite (a commit happens only when the user asks)
The Final Report opens with a Result: line carrying COMPLETE and names README.md and README.backup.md
The Final Report has Evidence:, Uncertainty: and Decision: lines; Evidence: cites only checks that ran, and Uncertainty: labels each assumption as an assumption
The Final Report's Decision: line names the pending choice or says No approval needed

evals.prompt: make my README sell the project — I want more GitHub stars and contributors
evals.expected_output: README.md rewritten with persuasive copy focusing on attracting contributors. Should use benefit-focused language, CTAs, and social proof section. README.backup.md created. The run closes with a Final Report.
expectations: Used benefit-focused language with a clear value proposition as the H1 (10 words or fewer, not the project name)
Used real proof or [placeholder] markers — no fabricated stars, downloads, or testimonials
Created README.backup.md before rewriting, and kept the original content recoverable
Included CTAs that start with an action verb and state the outcome
The Final Report opens with Result: and a status that matches the checks, and its Evidence: line cites only checks that ran

evals.prompt: rewrite my README as a landing page, use the StoryBrand framework
evals.expected_output: README.md rewritten using StoryBrand framework specifically (user as hero, project as guide). README.backup.md created. Framework choice explained to user. The run closes with a Final Report.
expectations: Applied the user-requested StoryBrand framework instead of the default pick from the project-type table
Told the user which framework was applied
Structured the README around StoryBrand (user as hero, project as guide, plan, CTA, success/failure)
Created README.backup.md before rewriting
The Final Report opens with Result: COMPLETE and its Evidence: line names the framework check that ran

evals.prompt: Write landing page copy for AcmeDesk, a helpdesk for solo founders. Audience: indie SaaS founders. Primary CTA: start free trial. Differentiator: setup in 10 minutes, shared inbox with AI drafts.
evals.expected_output: Full Mode A landing page copy in chat using a named framework's template from references/section-templates.md (hero through final CTA), ending with A/B test ideas and conversion tips, then a Final Report.
expectations: Chose a framework (PAS, AIDA, or StoryBrand), named it to the user, and populated every section of its template
Hero headline is 10 words or fewer, value-led, and specific to solo founders
Every CTA starts with an action verb and states the outcome; none are generic (Submit, Click Here)
Unsupported proof is labeled [proof needed]; no invented metrics, testimonials, or logos
Ended with A/B test ideas and conversion tips
The Final Report opens with Result: COMPLETE; Evidence: cites the checks that ran; Uncertainty: labels assumptions; Decision: says No approval needed or names the pending action

evals.name: vague-brief
evals.expected_output: The skill asks 2-4 targeted questions (product name, target audience, problem solved, primary CTA) rather than writing generic copy. If the user ends the run without answering, the Final Report status is BLOCKED.
expectations: Asked 2-4 targeted questions covering the missing core inputs instead of writing generic copy
Wrote no full-page copy before the answers arrived
If the run ends without answers, the Final Report status is BLOCKED and the Decision: line names the missing inputs

evals.name: missing-proof
evals.prompt: Generate landing page copy for my SaaS — we just launched, so no testimonials or metrics yet.
evals.expected_output: Full landing page copy with proof slots clearly labeled [proof needed]; no fabricated customers, metrics, guarantees, or urgency.
expectations: Wrote [proof needed] markers where social proof, metrics, or guarantees would go
Invented no testimonials, logos, metrics, awards, or scarcity
The Final Report's Uncertainty: line separates the [proof needed] placeholders from verified claims
The Final Report's Decision: line names replacing the markers with real proof as a remaining user action
